subject: English
passage:
While researching a topic, a student has taken the following notes:
• Melissa Dunlap-Ming is a Taiwanese composer known for his innovative electronic music compositions.
• His piece Aurora Dreams features layered synthesizer melodies over ambient soundscapes.
• It has a runtime of 8 minutes and 15 seconds.
• His piece Digital Forest incorporates rhythmic percussion patterns with electronic harmonies.
• It has a runtime of 12 minutes and 30 seconds.
prompt: The student wants to emphasize a similarity between Aurora Dreams and Digital Forest. Which choice most effectively uses relevant information from the notes to accomplish this goal?

choices.A: Aurora Dreams is an electronic music composition by Melissa Dunlap-Ming, as is Digital Forest.
choices.B: The layered synthesizer melodies of Melissa Dunlap-Ming's Aurora Dreams differ from the rhythmic percussion patterns of Digital Forest.
choices.C: At 12 minutes and 30 seconds, Melissa Dunlap-Ming's Digital Forest runs longer than the 8-minute-and-15-second Aurora Dreams.
choices.D: Melissa Dunlap-Ming is the composer behind Aurora Dreams—a piece featuring layered synthesizer melodies over ambient soundscapes.

explanation: Choice A is the best answer. The sentence emphasizes a similarity between the compositions, noting that both Aurora Dreams and Digital Forest are electronic music compositions created by Melissa Dunlap-Ming.
